comment: Ticketed exemptions for the declared-policy -> handler-enforcement lockstep gate (TestDeclaredPolicyEnforcedInLockstep, rpc_policy_lockstep_test.go). Every entry needs a procedure, a reason, and a ticket. Removing an entry re-arms the gate for that procedure; adding one is a reviewable event. Mirrors module/tools/authz-coverage-allowlist.json.

enforcement.reason: Legacy read-only stub. Enforces the SUPER_ADMIN floor via an inline service.Store().GetPlatformRole compare instead of requirePlatformRole, so the require*-based scanner cannot see it; the check is present and denies non-super-admins.
